question: When does depreciation begin?
options: When it is available for use
When it is first used in production
At the start of the next financial year
explanation: Available for use = in the location and condition necessary to operate as intended.
why_wrong: Purchase date may be earlier than availability.
Actual use may be later; depreciation still starts.
